brief.text: Closed-End Funds saw notable concentration in cluster activity across BPRE, NXG, and CRAFX, though drilling firm BORR generated the single largest total dollar value at $57,144,458 across three insiders. FUL recorded the highest breadth of internal participation with eight distinct insiders purchasing shares totaling $1,123,318, closely followed by RAPP with six buyers. Among notable individual transactions, institutional 10% owners accounted for the largest additions, led by Nippon Life Insurance Co’s $6,390,299 purchase in CRBG and Tether Global Investments Fund's $3,927,258 allocation to GOLD.
